comment: Enables Google AdWords conversion tracking on the storefront.
modal: When **Yes**, the AdWords conversion tracking snippet is added to the order success page. Set to **No** to remove it. Can be set per website or store view.

comment: The Google AdWords conversion ID that identifies your account for tracking.
modal: The conversion ID issued by Google AdWords, used to attribute storefront conversions to your account. Applies only when **Enable** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The language of the AdWords conversion tracking snippet.
modal: Selects the language used by the AdWords conversion tracking code. Applies only when **Enable** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: The Google AdWords conversion label paired with the conversion ID.
modal: The conversion label from AdWords that, together with the conversion ID, identifies the specific conversion action being tracked. Applies only when **Enable** is set to Yes. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether the tracked conversion value is a fixed amount or taken dynamically from the order.
modal: Chooses between reporting a constant conversion value and a value derived from each order. The choice determines whether **Conversion Value** or **Send Order Currency** applies. Applies only when **Enable** is set to Yes.

comment: The fixed conversion value reported to Google AdWords.
modal: The constant value sent with each tracked conversion. Applies only when **Enable** is Yes and **Conversion Value Type** is set to a fixed value. Can differ per website or store view.

comment: Whether to send the order currency with the dynamic conversion value.
modal: When **Yes**, the order's currency is included alongside the conversion value. Applies only when **Enable** is Yes and **Conversion Value Type** uses the dynamic order value. Can differ per website or store view.
